text.p: Ecuadorean President Abdala Bucaram belted out songs and danced on stage at a concert on Wednesday night where he presented his first compact disc entitled "A Madman in Love."
The flamboyant new president was wearing casual trousers and a black sports shirt and flanked by family members and government aides as he played to a crowd of thousands.
"The truth is that I am not a very fine singer, but I am a person who sings with passion," Bucaram acknowledged after the concert in his home coastal city of Guayaquil.
Part of the profits from the disc will be donated to a charity for poor children. Its cover displays an Ecuadorean flag with a picture of Bucaram wearing the presidential sash.

During the recent electoral campaign, Bucaram, who took office in August, performed several times at concerts where he sang Spanish rock tunes. The title of the album refers to his nickname, "El Loco" ("The Madman"), which he earned for his stunts in electoral campaigns.
